title: LOC Current Governance
highest_principle: LOC provides inspectable information, rules, sources, context, differences, uncertainty, and disputes. It does not decide for the user which view must be correct.

document_governance.current_rule: Current Governance is the single decision layer for current architecture and terminology.
document_governance.history_rule: Historical material preserves provenance and evolution but has no authority to overwrite Current.
document_governance.implementation_rule: Implementation notes, migration notes, PR summaries, TODOs and validation artifacts cannot define governance.
document_governance.new_document_rule: Do not create a new decision document when the subject belongs to an existing authority source. Update the authority source instead.
document_governance.conflict_rule: When old material conflicts with Current, preserve the old state only as history and use Current for implementation.

governance_principles: Current first; history preserved without contaminating Current.
Spec and master data outrank derived descriptions.
No-API explainable classification is preferred where applicable.
Same name does not imply same entity.
Analysis and inference do not constitute final judgment.
Scope, provenance, ownership and authority boundaries must remain inspectable.

current_architecture.model: Scope Model × Feature Model → Page Composition
current_architecture.admin: admin.lo3rwang.cc is a system administration UI and is not a Scope.

legacy_loc_numbering.rule: LOC1–LOC8 numbering is not the Current architecture, Current Canon, Current governance model, homepage framing, or default classification basis.
legacy_loc_numbering.allowed_use: It may appear only when identifying historical artifacts, legacy filenames, datasets, migration provenance, or explicit historical discussion.
legacy_loc_numbering.forbidden_use: Do not infer current system structure from LOC1–LOC8 prefixes and do not begin a Current explanation by mapping LOC to LOC1–LOC8.

classification_order: part of speech / semantic role in sentence
lunarunes_authority.group_assignment: A classification result has one unique group value. Close alternatives may be reported as disputes without becoming multiple assigned groups.

zhengde_style_current.principle: Definition → axiom → inference → counterexample → calibration → application.
rules: Inference expands possibilities rather than manufacturing a single answer.
Trends do not replace human choice.
Systems must know their own boundaries.
Imagination may open possibilities; causal consistency remains accountable to established conditions.
zhengde_style_current.history_location: Historical formation belongs to Culture / Governance history, not the personal homepage Current definition.

historical_provenance.repository_history: Superseded Markdown documents and earlier Canon drafts remain recoverable from Git history.
historical_provenance.rule: Historical preservation does not require keeping obsolete decision files visible in the Current working tree.
